name: Dr. Masoud Goharimanesh
title: Associate Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering
bio: Founder and director of ARCSLAB. His research combines robotics, intelligent control and engineering design: fuzzy and (safe) reinforcement-learning control of continuum and soft robots, robust QFT control, vehicle dynamics, control of MEMS/NEMS devices, and Taguchi/AI-based design optimization. He collaborates with the Robotics, Mechatronics and Automation Laboratory (RMAL) at Toronto Metropolitan University and shares 700+ free video tutorials on his Aparat channel.
interests: Continuum & soft robotics; Reinforcement learning & fuzzy control; Robust (QFT) control; Vehicle dynamics; MEMS/NEMS control; Taguchi & AI-based optimization
skills: MATLAB/Simulink; Python; SOFA; Control design; Design of experiments

name: Dr. Ali Koochi
title: Associate Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering
bio: Co-founder of ARCSLAB. For more than fifteen years his research has followed one line — size-dependent mechanics, surface effects, electromechanical (pull-in) instability, MEMS/NEMS devices and nanosensors — and now extends to their intelligent control. He is co-author of the Elsevier book “Nonlinear Differential Equations in Micro/nano Mechanics” (2020) and teaches the Finite Element Method.
interests: Theoretical & nonlinear mechanics; MEMS/NEMS and pull-in instability; Casimir & van der Waals forces; Non-classical (size-dependent) continuum theories; Nanotweezers & nanosensors; Finite element method
skills: Analytical & numerical methods; GDQ; Finite element analysis; MATLAB

name: Mahdi Jahangiri
title: MSc Student
bio: Mahdi studies soft robots made of Soft PLA and the 3D-printing (FDM) methods used to fabricate them. He also simulates his designs in the SOFA framework.
research_topic: Soft-PLA soft robots: 3D-printing fabrication and SOFA simulation
skills: FDM 3D printing; Soft PLA; SOFA framework

name: Fatemeh Shamsian
title: MSc Student
bio: Fatemeh works on soft robots and their modeling with Cosserat rod theory. She has designed and built a soft tentacle prototype that she uses to compare the model with real behavior.
research_topic: Cosserat-rod modeling of soft robots and a soft tentacle prototype
skills: Cosserat rod theory; Soft robotics; Prototyping

name: Abolfazl Hasanzadeh
title: MSc Student
bio: Abolfazl uses a continuum robot to help keep a mini buggy (a small electric vehicle) stable, taking inspiration from the way a mouse moves. His work joins vehicle dynamics with continuum robotics.
research_topic: Bio-inspired continuum robot for the stability of a mini buggy
skills: Vehicle dynamics; Continuum robots; Bio-inspired design

name: Mohammadreza Goharimanesh
title: MSc Student
bio: Mohammadreza works on the motion of brittle stars to fabricate a soft robot like brittle stars.
research_topic: Modeling, Simulation, Fabrication and control of a brtittle star like soft robot

name: Alireza Alipoor Aval
title: MSc Student
bio: Alireza works on two continuum robots working side by side that grasp and move an object together. He uses reinforcement learning to control the cooperation, has built the robots with 3D printing and continues the work in SOFA.
research_topic: Cooperative continuum robots controlled by reinforcement learning

name: Mohammad Yoosefian
title: MSc Student
bio: Mohammad builds silicone soft robots driven by PneuNet actuators with a special geometry. To improve the design he uses design of experiments with the Taguchi method.
research_topic: Silicone PneuNet soft actuators optimized with the Taguchi method
skills: Silicone casting; PneuNet actuators; Taguchi design of experiments

name: Mojtaba Khajehzadeh
title: MSc Student
bio: Mojtaba is developing a new type of continuum robot with no soft body, built only from four-pronged (fork) joints. He has built an accurate prototype and tests the design in the MuJoCo simulator.
research_topic: Fork-joint continuum robot without a soft body

name: Mohsen Azadi
title: MSc Student
bio: Mohsen solves the governing equations of soft robots with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and verifies his results against SOFA simulations.
research_topic: Physics-informed neural networks for soft-robot mechanics

name: Reza Abbaszadeh
title: BSc Student
bio: Reza works on artificial-intelligence models and machine vision for robotics.

name: Seyed Hossein Hoseini
title: BSc Student

name: Mojtaba Shirmohammadi
title: BSc Student
bio: Mojtaba works on electronic circuits. His goal is to build a Cartesian plotter that can also cut and make printed-circuit boards (PCBs).
research_topic: Cartesian plotter for cutting and making PCBs

name: Sajjad Heydari
title: BSc Student
bio: Sajjad is building the Amazing Hand, a 3D-printed robotic hand. He has printed the parts and is now working on its assembly and, finally, its control.
research_topic: Amazing Hand — 3D-printed robotic hand: assembly and control
